name: DENC3CID11ConceptMap
title: DEN.C3 ConceptMap to ICD-11 MMS
description: Candidate terminology mappings for DEN.C3 local concepts to ICD-11 MMS. Mappings are inexact/narrower and require terminology review; unsupported concepts are explicitly unmapped.

text.div:
Mappings are candidate relationships from the source data dictionary and secondary mapping workbook. They are not independently terminology-validated. Inexact and narrower relations intentionally avoid claiming exact equivalence.

  • hypotensive-shock: Source code is titled Shock, broader than hypotensive shock; candidate requires terminology review.
  • severe-bleeding: Source code is a broad haemorrhage category; candidate requires terminology review.
  • severe-organ-impairment: Source code is more specific than severe organ impairment; validate the intended clinical concept.
  • no-danger-sign: The source has no classifiable ICD-11 code for this concept.
  • oral-fluid-intake-volume: The source has no classifiable ICD-11 code for this concept.
